dialogues.jp:
俺の家族が引っ越してきた家の隣には、魔法使
いが住んでいた――。
dialogues.en:
There was a witch in the house next door when my family
moved into this house.
dialogues.text:
There was a witch in the house next door when my family
moved into this house.

dialogues.jp:
別にボロ家ではないけれど、新しくもない、た
しかに妖怪でも住んでいそうな日本家屋。
dialogues.en:
It was a traditional Japanese style house. It wasn't a new
house but not a crappy old house either. I could imagine
some monster living in that house.
dialogues.text:
It was a traditional Japanese style house. It wasn't a new
house but not a crappy old house either. I could imagine
some monster living in that house.

dialogues.jp:
子供の頃、登下校のたびに、俺はついその家を
｛かきね／垣根｝の隙間から覗き込んでいた。
dialogues.en:
I used to peek into the house from the hole of the fence
every time I walked by the house when I was small.
dialogues.text:
I used to peek into the house from the hole of the fence
every time I walked by the house when I was small.

dialogues.jp: 建物に興味があったんじゃない。
dialogues.en: I wasn't looking at the house.
dialogues.text: I wasn't looking at the house.

dialogues.jp:
その家には広い庭があって、その日当たりのよ
い縁側で、いつもひとりのばあちゃんが白い猫
を抱いて座っていた。
dialogues.en:
It had a huge yard and an old lady would be sitting at the
patio in the sun holding a white cat.
dialogues.text:
It had a huge yard and an old lady would be sitting at the
patio in the sun holding a white cat.

dialogues.jp:
ばあちゃんは遠い国からやってきた人で、髪が
金色で、瞳が青かった。
dialogues.en:
This old lady came from a faraway land, and she had blonde
hair and blue eyes.
dialogues.text:
This old lady came from a faraway land, and she had blonde
hair and blue eyes.

dialogues.jp:
だが、印象に残っているのはそんな外見ではな
く――いつも幸せそうな笑顔だった。
dialogues.en:
But what I remember the most is her smile instead of how she
looked outside.
dialogues.text:
But what I remember the most is her smile instead of how she
looked outside.

dialogues.jp:
実際のところ、彼女は俺の母方の祖母で、その
土地を借りていたのが俺達なのだが……。
dialogues.en:
Actually, she was my grandmother on my mother's side and we
were living on her property......
dialogues.text:
Actually, she was my grandmother on my mother's side and we
were living on her property......

dialogues.jp: まだ、一度も話をしたことはなかった。
dialogues.en: But I haven't spoken to her once.
dialogues.text: But I haven't spoken to her once.

dialogues.jp: これは誰の夢だ？
dialogues.en: Who's dreaming this?
dialogues.text: Who's dreaming this?

dialogues.jp: 久しぶりに見る景色。
dialogues.en: I haven't seen this place for a long time.
dialogues.text: I haven't seen this place for a long time.

dialogues.jp: 音。
dialogues.en: The sound.
dialogues.text: The sound.

dialogues.jp: 風。
dialogues.en: The wind.
dialogues.text: The wind.

dialogues.en: The cherry blossom tree.
dialogues.text: The cherry blossom tree.

dialogues.jp: 白い夢を見た。
dialogues.en: I had a white dream.
dialogues.text: I had a white dream.

dialogues.jp: ただ白い――
dialogues.en: It was just white...
dialogues.text: It was just white...

dialogues.jp: 真っ白い――
dialogues.en: Pure white...
dialogues.text: Pure white...

dialogues.jp: 春の匂いを感じる心地よい夢。
dialogues.en: It was a relaxing dream with a hint of spring.
dialogues.text: It was a relaxing dream with a hint of spring.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「お父さん……お母さん……」
泣いているのは誰だ？
dialogues.en: Who's crying?
dialogues.text: Who's crying?

dialogues.jp: 音夢？
dialogues.en: Is it Nemu?
dialogues.text: Is it Nemu?

dialogues.jp: どうして泣いているんだろう。
dialogues.en: Why's she crying?
dialogues.text: Why's she crying?

dialogues.jp: 守らなくてはいけない。
dialogues.en: I have to protect her.
dialogues.text: I have to protect her.

dialogues.jp: なにがあろうとも。
dialogues.en: No matter what happens.
dialogues.text: No matter what happens.

dialogues.jp: それが決まりだから。
dialogues.en: That's what I have to do.
dialogues.text: That's what I have to do.

dialogues.jp: 音夢をお願いと、アイツの両親に頼まれたから。
dialogues.en: Because I made a promise to her parents.
dialogues.text: Because I made a promise to her parents.

dialogues.jp: いや――
dialogues.en: I guess...
dialogues.text: I guess...

dialogues.jp:
あの瞬間から、音夢はいつか別れる妹ではなく、
ずっと守らなくちゃいけない存在になった。
dialogues.en:
Since that moment on, Nemu wasn't my sister who would leave
me to get married, but instead she became a person I had to
protect for the rest of my life.
dialogues.text:
Since that moment on, Nemu wasn't my sister who would leave
me to get married, but instead she became a person I had to
protect for the rest of my life.

dialogues.jp: 誰でもない。
dialogues.en: Nobody else,
dialogues.text: Nobody else,

dialogues.jp: 俺が、俺に誓ったから。
dialogues.en: But I promised myself.
dialogues.text: But I promised myself.

dialogues.jp: なにか違う。
dialogues.en: Something's different.
dialogues.text: Something's different.

dialogues.jp: いつもと違う感覚の夢。
dialogues.en: It felt different than my usual dreams.
dialogues.text: It felt different than my usual dreams.

dialogues.jp:
｛そうまとう／走馬燈｝のように流れているというか、俺の夢を
誰かに覗かれているような――。
dialogues.en: It felt like someone was watching my dream......
dialogues.text: It felt like someone was watching my dream......

dialogues.jp:
仲の良かったアイツの両親は、俺に音夢のこと
を任せると笑顔で出かけたきり、戻っては来な
かった……。
dialogues.en:
Her parents asked me to take care of Nemu and smiled as they
went out, and never returned.
dialogues.text:
Her parents asked me to take care of Nemu and smiled as they
went out, and never returned.

dialogues.jp:
いや……戻ってきたときには、子供心にも小さ
くみすぼらしく見えた棺桶におさまり、白い姿
になっていた。
dialogues.en:
Or I should say, they returned in small caskets wearing
white burial clothes.
dialogues.text:
Or I should say, they returned in small caskets wearing
white burial clothes.

dialogues.jp: 交通事故だと言われた。
dialogues.en: I was told it was a car accident.
dialogues.text: I was told it was a car accident.

dialogues.jp:
人の死にまだピンとこなかった俺は、むしろ残
された音夢が泣いている姿だけが痛々しかった。
dialogues.en:
I didn't understand death at the time, and felt bad for Nemu
who kept crying.
dialogues.text:
I didn't understand death at the time, and felt bad for Nemu
who kept crying.

dialogues.jp:
それ以上に、アイツが家に泊まるようになって、
俺の部屋が半分横取りされて、お風呂まで一緒
にされたことに腹が立っていた……。
dialogues.en:
I was more upset about Nemu staying at our house, and she
took over half of my room, and they made us bathe together.
dialogues.text:
I was more upset about Nemu staying at our house, and she
took over half of my room, and they made us bathe together.

dialogues.jp: ｛・・・・・・・／かったるかった｝のだ……アイツの存在が。
dialogues.en: It was too much for me.
dialogues.text: It was too much for me.

dialogues.jp: アイツは毎晩泣いていた。
dialogues.en: She was crying every night.
dialogues.text: She was crying every night.

dialogues.jp:
すぐ隣の布団の中で、必死に声を殺して泣いて
いた。
dialogues.en:
She was suppressing her cry as she covered herself in a
comforter next to me.
dialogues.text:
She was suppressing her cry as she covered herself in a
comforter next to me.

dialogues.jp: それを毎晩聞きながら、俺は毎晩考えていた。
dialogues.en: I was thinking every night while listening to her cry.
dialogues.text: I was thinking every night while listening to her cry.

dialogues.jp:
アイツが｛うっとう／鬱陶｝しいのか、どうでもいい奴なのか、
守ってやりたいのか……。
dialogues.en:
Whether she was bothering me, or if I didn't care about her,
or if I wanted to protect her.
dialogues.text:
Whether she was bothering me, or if I didn't care about her,
or if I wanted to protect her.

dialogues.jp: そんな時だった――
dialogues.en: That was when ----
dialogues.text: That was when ----

dialogues.jp:
トイレの帰りに、誕生日が一緒のアイツを、俺
の姉にするか妹にするか話している両親の言葉
を盗み聞きしたのは。
dialogues.en:
I overheard my parents talking about if Nemu should be my
younger or older sister since we were born on the same date.
dialogues.text:
I overheard my parents talking about if Nemu should be my
younger or older sister since we were born on the same date.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「お父さん……お母さん……」

部屋に戻ると、暗闇の中で、音夢は声を漏らし
ていた。
dialogues.en: Nemu was crying in the dark when I got back to my room.
dialogues.text: Nemu was crying in the dark when I got back to my room.

dialogues.jp: 「……おぃ、お前」
dialogues.en: "Hey, you......"
dialogues.text: "Hey, you......"

dialogues.jp: 俺は立ったまま声をかけた。
dialogues.en: I talked to her while standing up.
dialogues.text: I talked to her while standing up.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「おぃ」
dialogues.en: "Hey."
dialogues.text: "Hey."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いい加減うるさいんだよ」
dialogues.en: "Stop that already."
dialogues.text: "Stop that already."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……っく……ごめん」
dialogues.en: "S-Sorry."
dialogues.text: "S-Sorry."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「謝らなくてもいいから、泣きやめよ」
dialogues.en: "Don't be sorry, but stop crying."
dialogues.text: "Don't be sorry, but stop crying."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "...Sigh."
dialogues.text: "...Sigh."

dialogues.jp: 返事を聞いて、俺は自分の布団にもぐりこんだ。
dialogues.en: I went back into my bed as she answered.
dialogues.text: I went back into my bed as she answered.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "...Sob... boohoo..."
dialogues.text: "...Sob... boohoo..."

dialogues.jp: しばらくして、またアイツがぐずりだす。
dialogues.en: And then she started to cry again.
dialogues.text: And then she started to cry again.

dialogues.jp: ――ああ、なんてヤツだ！
dialogues.en: She needs to stop that!
dialogues.text: She needs to stop that!

dialogues.jp: 「おい音夢」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Nemu."
dialogues.text: "Hey, Nemu."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「な、なに？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
そういえば、この時、はじめてアイツの呼び方
が変わった。
dialogues.en: This was when I started to call her by her name.
dialogues.text: This was when I started to call her by her name.

dialogues.jp: 「こっちの布団に来い」
dialogues.en: "Come over here."
dialogues.text: "Come over here."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「つべこべ言わずに来い」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry about it, come on."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry about it, come on."

dialogues.jp: ひとりだからうるさいのだ。
dialogues.en: She was crying because she was alone.
dialogues.text: She was crying because she was alone.

dialogues.jp:
俺が隣にいてやってるのに、それでも音夢は自
分ひとりだと泣いているのだ。
dialogues.en:
She didn't notice me by her side, and she was still crying
thinking she was alone.
dialogues.text:
She didn't notice me by her side, and she was still crying
thinking she was alone.

dialogues.jp: ごそごそ――。
dialogues.en: She came into my bed.
dialogues.text: She came into my bed.

dialogues.jp: 布団まで半分になった。
dialogues.en: Now I had to share my bed as well.
dialogues.text: Now I had to share my bed as well.

dialogues.jp:
すごく身体の冷たい奴で、暖かさまで半分になっ
た。
dialogues.en:
She was a cold blooded person, so the warmth of my bed was
taken away too.
dialogues.text:
She was a cold blooded person, so the warmth of my bed was
taken away too.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……あったかい」
dialogues.en: "This is so warm."
dialogues.text: "This is so warm."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「音夢、今度からお前は俺の妹だ」
dialogues.en: "Nemu, you're my sister from now on."
dialogues.text: "Nemu, you're my sister from now on."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「俺のおやつも、親もお前に半分やる」
dialogues.en: "I'll give you half of my sweets and my parents as well."
dialogues.text: "I'll give you half of my sweets and my parents as well."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だけど、お前がお姉さんだなんて嫌だからな」
dialogues.en: "But I don't want you to be my older sister."
dialogues.text: "But I don't want you to be my older sister."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「う……うん」
dialogues.en: "O-Okay..."
dialogues.text: "O-Okay..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「それと、なんでも謝らなくていい」
dialogues.en: "And you don't have to apologize to me."
dialogues.text: "And you don't have to apologize to me."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「俺は音夢のお兄さんだからな……これで寝れ
　るぞ」
dialogues.en: "I'm your brother and you can go to sleep now."
dialogues.text: "I'm your brother and you can go to sleep now."

dialogues.jp: 俺は目を閉じてため息をついた。
dialogues.en: I closed my eyes and sighed.
dialogues.text: I closed my eyes and sighed.

dialogues.jp: すげーかったるい。
dialogues.en: What a pain.
dialogues.text: What a pain.

dialogues.jp: ――まぁ、簡単に言えば｛・・・／強がり｝なのだ。
dialogues.en: I guess I was trying to be bold.
dialogues.text: I guess I was trying to be bold.

dialogues.jp: 最初から音夢を嫌ってなどいなかった。
dialogues.en: I never disliked Nemu.
dialogues.text: I never disliked Nemu.

dialogues.jp:
男が女を守るのに、子供心には｛・・／理由｝が必要だっ
たのだ。
dialogues.en:
As a child, I just needed an excuse to promise myself to
protect her.
dialogues.text:
As a child, I just needed an excuse to promise myself to
protect her.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……分かった……お兄ちゃん」
dialogues.en: "Okay...... oniichan."
dialogues.text: "Okay...... oniichan."

dialogues.jp: 音夢が俺に抱きついてくる。
dialogues.en: Nemu gave me a hug.
dialogues.text: Nemu gave me a hug.

dialogues.jp:
そしてそのまま泣きだしてしまったが、今度は
文句を言わず、俺は手を握って目を開けなかっ
た。
dialogues.en:
And she cried again, but I didn't complain. I held her hand
and didn't open my eyes.
dialogues.text:
And she cried again, but I didn't complain. I held her hand
and didn't open my eyes.

dialogues.jp: 袖をひっぱられて、なんだか胸が冷たく濡れた。
dialogues.en:
She pulled on my sleeve and my pajamas got wet from her
tears.
dialogues.text:
She pulled on my sleeve and my pajamas got wet from her
tears.

dialogues.jp: それは懐かしい夢で。
dialogues.en: It was a nostalgic dream.
dialogues.text: It was a nostalgic dream.

dialogues.jp: 音夢が妹になった日の夢。
dialogues.en: A dream of the day Nemu became my sister.
dialogues.text: A dream of the day Nemu became my sister.

dialogues.jp: そして次の日――音夢は姿を消した。
dialogues.en: Then Nemu disappeared the next day.
dialogues.text: Then Nemu disappeared the next day.

dialogues.jp: 次の次の日になっても帰ってこなかった。
dialogues.en: She didn't return the next day, or the day after that.
dialogues.text: She didn't return the next day, or the day after that.

dialogues.jp: 俺は空っぽになってしまった手を見つめた。
dialogues.en: I looked at my empty hand.
dialogues.text: I looked at my empty hand.

dialogues.jp: それは夕暮れの屋上。
dialogues.en: It was at the rooftop of the building at dusk.
dialogues.text: It was at the rooftop of the building at dusk.

dialogues.jp: 渦を巻き、空に風が上っている。
dialogues.en: The wind was swirling up into the sky.
dialogues.text: The wind was swirling up into the sky.

dialogues.jp: 赤と青がまじった地球の天井。
dialogues.en: The red and blue were all mixed at the top of the sky.
dialogues.text: The red and blue were all mixed at the top of the sky.

dialogues.jp: 夢の……。
dialogues.en: The dream......
dialogues.text: The dream......

dialogues.jp: 終わる瞬間。
dialogues.en: The end of it.
dialogues.text: The end of it.

dialogues.jp: （今度は……なんだ……？）
dialogues.en: (What's next?)
dialogues.text: (What's next?)

dialogues.jp: っ。
dialogues.en: Ouch.
dialogues.text: Ouch.

dialogues.jp: 音夢がいる。
dialogues.en: I found Nemu.
dialogues.text: I found Nemu.

dialogues.jp: 背中越しに音夢が立っているのが分かる。
dialogues.en: I sensed Nemu standing behind me.
dialogues.text: I sensed Nemu standing behind me.

dialogues.jp:
声をかけようとしても、振り返ろうとしても
――どうしても身体が動かない。
dialogues.en:
I wanted to talk to her and turn around, but I couldn't move
my body at all.
dialogues.text:
I wanted to talk to her and turn around, but I couldn't move
my body at all.

dialogues.jp: （夢……だよな？）
dialogues.en: (Is this a dream?)
dialogues.text: (Is this a dream?)

dialogues.jp: （これも誰かの夢なんだよな？）
dialogues.en: (Could it be someone else's dream?)
dialogues.text: (Could it be someone else's dream?)

dialogues.jp: 俺はどうしてしまったのか……。
dialogues.en: What's going on with me?
dialogues.text: What's going on with me?

dialogues.jp: 今までの支離滅裂な夢もそうだが……こんな。
dialogues.en: The previous dreams were inconsistent, but......
dialogues.text: The previous dreams were inconsistent, but......

dialogues.jp: こんな風景は知らない……。
dialogues.en: I don't recognize this place......
dialogues.text: I don't recognize this place......

dialogues.jp:
こんな……信じられないくらい胸が痛い記憶も
望みもない。
dialogues.en: I don't have this kind of painful memory either......
dialogues.text: I don't have this kind of painful memory either......

dialogues.jp: ……痛い。
dialogues.en: It's painful.
dialogues.text: It's painful.

dialogues.jp: このまま死んでしまいたくなるくらい……痛い。
dialogues.en: It hurts so bad that I wish I was dead.
dialogues.text: It hurts so bad that I wish I was dead.

dialogues.jp: そんな夢を誰が見ているのか？
dialogues.en: Who could be dreaming such a painful dream?
dialogues.text: Who could be dreaming such a painful dream?

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「『さよならだね……兄さん』」
dialogues.en: ""Goodbye... niisan.""
dialogues.text: ""Goodbye... niisan.""

dialogues.jp: ◆乱れる夢◆
dialogues.en: ◆Confusing dream◆
dialogues.text: ◆Confusing dream◆

dialogues.jp: 夢を見た。
dialogues.en: I dreamed.
dialogues.text: I dreamed.

dialogues.jp:
ばあちゃんの夢と、音夢が妹になったときの夢
を。
dialogues.en:
It was about my grandmother and about the day Nemu became my
sister.
dialogues.text:
It was about my grandmother and about the day Nemu became my
sister.

dialogues.jp: そしてもうひとつ……。誰のだか分からない夢。
dialogues.en: And something else. It was someone else's dream.
dialogues.text: And something else. It was someone else's dream.

dialogues.jp:
このまま死んでしまいたくなるくらい……痛い
夢。
dialogues.en: The most painful dream I ever had.
dialogues.text: The most painful dream I ever had.
